podcast.title: Sexual Harassment Accusation Against Martin Lawrence (1996)
podcast.body: In November 1996, she accused Martin Lawrence and the producers of the show *Martin* of "repeated and escalating sexual harassment, sexual battery, verbal abuse, and related threats." She subsequently refused to come to set for the remainder of what ended up being the final season. She only agreed to return for the series finale in May 1997 on the condition that Martin Lawrence not be present when she was on set. The lawsuit was ultimately settled out of court. "Then in November 1996, Lawrence's co-star Tisha Campbell accused the comedian and producers of repeated and escalating sexual harassment, sexual battery, verbal abuse, and related threats."

podcast.title: Martin Reboot Possibility
podcast.body: She recently told Entertainment Tonight that there is a "definite possibility" for a *Martin* series reboot, provided that schedules can align. "Most recently Tisha Campbell told Entertainment tonight that there is a definite possibility as long as schedules align."
